claims.claim: SWI Compute's first large-scale AI factory in the UK starts with 30 MW, close to 7,000 Rubin GPUs and 3,500 Vera CPUs in Vera Rubin NVL72 racks, expected online by the end of 2027.
claims.episode_span: announced at 30 MW in the UK, with close to 7,000 Rubin GPUs and 3,500 Vera CPUs
claims.source_title: SWI Compute Emerges from Stealth to Turn Gigawatts of Power Into NVIDIA AI Factories, Starting in Europe
claims.supporting_quote: Its first large-scale AI factory in the UK starts with 30 MW, close to 7,000 Rubin GPUs and 3,500 Vera CPUs in NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 racks, expected to come online by the end of 2027.

claims.claim: SWI Group holds 3.6 GW of power capacity across Europe and the US, and SWI Compute ordered approximately $1 billion of NVIDIA systems.
claims.episode_span: holds 3.6 GW of power capacity across 24 sites in Europe and the US
claims.source_title: SWI Compute Emerges from Stealth to Turn Gigawatts of Power Into NVIDIA AI Factories, Starting in Europe
claims.supporting_quote: The global AI infrastructure company is backed by 3.6 gigawatts of power capacity that SWI Group has spent six years securing across Europe and the US.

claims.claim: NVIDIA's updated Vera Rubin NVL72 specification lists 1,400 TB/s total memory bandwidth, down from 1,580 TB/s, with HBM4 reduced from 11.7 Gbps per pin to 9.6 Gbps per pin.
claims.episode_span: Vera Rubin NVL72 total memory bandwidth moves from the previously advertised 1,580 TB/s to 1,400 TB/s
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA now offers a total memory bandwidth of 1,400 TB/s, down from the previously advertised 1,580 TB/s.

claims.claim: NVLink bandwidth per GPU was reduced from 1.8 TB/s to 1.5 TB/s, and the reported Nyquist frequency target from 56 GHz to 47 GHz.
claims.episode_span: NVLink bandwidth per GPU falls from 1.8 TB/s to 1.5 TB/s
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Cuts HBM4 Speed and NVLink Bandwidth Targets for Vera Rubin
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA has also reduced the previously advertised NVLink bandwidth per GPU, decreasing it from 1.8 TB/s to 1.5 TB/s.

claims.claim: E2E Networks proposed adding about 5.4 MW for NVIDIA HGX B300 and other Blackwell GPUs on top of about 9.2 MW.
claims.episode_span: proposed about 5.4 MW of additional capacity for NVIDIA HGX B300 systems and other Blackwell GPUs
claims.source_title: AI Stock Hits Upper Circuit After Announcing NVIDIA GPU Expansion Plans
claims.supporting_quote: The company has now proposed adding about 5.4 MW of capacity for NVIDIA HGX B300 systems and other Blackwell GPUs, on top of its existing capacity of around 9.2 MW.

claims.claim: Dylan Patel said there are 117.5 GW of behind-the-meter power orders being delivered and installed in the next few years.
claims.episode_span: 117.5 GW of behind-the-meter power orders being delivered and installed over the next few years
claims.supporting_quote: There's 117.5GW of BTM power orders and being delivered and installed in the next few years.

claims.claim: A one-megawatt orbital computing scenario in Turyshev's April 2026 study required about 5,640 square meters of photovoltaic arrays and 2,500 square meters of radiators.
claims.episode_span: required approximately 5,640 square meters of photovoltaic arrays and 2,500 square meters of radiators
claims.source_title: In Orbit, Useful Life Becomes a Performance Metric
claims.supporting_quote: In one representative one-megawatt scenario, the model required approximately 5,640 square meters of photovoltaic arrays and 2,500 square meters of radiators.

claims.claim: Jensen Huang said it costs about $2,000 per GPU per year to run the NVIDIA software that powers agents in AI factories.
claims.episode_span: it costs about $2,000 per GPU per year to run the NVIDIA software that powers agents
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Eyes Software Revenue With a $2,000 per GPU Yearly Figure From Huang
claims.supporting_quote: Huang said software licensing will become a growing part of NVIDIA's business, and that it costs about $2,000 per GPU per year to run all the NVIDIA software that powers agents in AI factories.
